structural_methods.coverage_method: COMPLETE requires the observed team set's inferred double round-robin total and exactly one match for every directed home-away pair. NEAR_COMPLETE requires at least 90 percent of that inferred total and no repeated directed pair. Other coverage is PARTIAL. This is a structural cache classification, not a nominal league-size claim.
structural_methods.same_kickoff_batch_rule: All matches sharing local match_date and kick_off are evaluated against state before that batch, then team and competition counts are advanced for the whole batch.
structural_methods.target_rule: competition prior matches >= 100 and both teams have at least 10 prior appearances
structural_methods.warmup: Competition prior matches must be at least 100; this implements the first-100-match WARMUP_ONLY rule without letting same-kickoff matches observe one another.
